engineering_gates.name: Financial correctness
engineering_gates.evidence: Real filing on the release commit (Apple FY2026 10-K, accession 0000320193-26-000026): 45/45 acceptance steps. The answer is 478,834 million; the cited cell's column label '2026' equals the resolved period, citation_quality 'exact'; segment rows recompute to the table's own total and the certificate is independently verified. Seven adversarial period-alignment tests cover currency separator columns, Change columns, shifted and multi-level headers, a header that cannot cover its values, and the API's 422 citation_period_conflict refusal. Offline synthetic acceptance 30/30.

engineering_gates.name: Historical / point-in-time integrity
engineering_gates.evidence: Availability is reported with precision (unknown/date/exact) and modelled bounds are labelled as bounds; cutoffs exclude rather than back-fill. The real-filing acceptance asserts precision=unknown, estimated=true and the exact note text on the release commit.

engineering_gates.name: Security audit of the candidate
engineering_gates.evidence: SQL inventory: 49 interpolated statements, all classified in docs/SECURITY_SQL_INTERPOLATION.json (21 placeholders_only, 24 review, 4 structure_named) and reviewed in docs/SECURITY_SQL_REVIEW.md; each of the four structure splices is controlled by an enum, a module constant or the _SAFE_IDENTIFIER guard, with 9 adversarial tests. Bounded resource audit on the release commit: 8 pass, 0 fail, 1 not run (expensive model request, no provider configured); a 31.3 MB filing is refused at the 24 MiB ingestion limit, a ZIP bomb and a 200-entry package are refused, 200 consecutive invalid requests are all 4xx with the server healthy afterwards, 20 dropped connections leave the server healthy, and 4 concurrent MCP sessions answer initialize. Dependency scan clean across Python (65 packages) and npm (0 findings). No credential or secret shape in the tree.

engineering_gates.name: Documentation accuracy
engineering_gates.evidence: Every measured number is stated; unrun validations are named as unrun. This release corrects the two CLI defects that installing the published 0.2.0b1 wheel exposed: --db is a global option and must precede the subcommand, demo/serve/mcp accept --db-path, and no --version flag exists. All install instructions, the user guide, the verification page, the landing page and the runbook were corrected; the version is consistent across the package attribute, pyproject dynamic version, web package and API health; and the unsupported Python 3.11 claim was removed. A second pass against the published PyPI package found that `atlas doctor --json` does not report the release version; the instructions now name only surfaces that do (/api/health release_version, pip show atlas-quant, atlas.__release_label__).

decision_basis: Every engineering gate passes on the exact artifacts built after the licence was applied: real-filing citation integrity, the full browser journey, packaged installation of the distributed wheel, MCP interoperability and reproducible artifacts.
The software licence gate now passes: Apache-2.0 is applied with a named copyright holder and travels inside the wheel and sdist, and the third-party notices are effective.
The data-rights gate passes for the distribution: no restricted vendor material exists in the tree or in any artifact, and the public source candidate has zero restricted objects reachable.

Two distribution gates remain blocked and both are GitHub administrative actions this environment cannot perform: renaming and restricting the development repository, creating and publishing the replacement public repository, creating the release, enabling Pages, and uploading to PyPI. The registry therefore keeps the private-candidate decision and records the publication verdict separately.
Validation milestones (independent human evaluation, external usability, adoption) are NOT RUN and no release claim depends on them.

Confirm that no employer, client or funding agreement claims the contributed code, as recorded in licenses/AUTHORIZATION-RECORD.md (still an open maintainer confirmation).
The shipped CLI has no --version flag; this release documents the surfaces that do report the release version instead of adding a feature.
